stories.title: Toronto zoo announces birth of pygmy hippo calf, third for mother Kindia
bullet_points: The 20-year-old’s third calf is being monitored by officials as survival rates for the species are challenging, the zoo said  The Toronto Zoo has announced the birth of a female pygmy hippo calf.
Kindia, the zoo’s 20-year-old pygmy hippo, started showing signs of labor at around 8.15am last Sunday, it said.
Around four hours later, the calf’s feet emerged and after 1.5 hours of active labor, Kindia successfully gave birth to the baby pygmy hippo.

stories.title: Mexican influencer shot dead while streaming live on social media
bullet_points: César Gastélum was filming outside a fast-food outlet in Sinaloa state when he was killed by a motorbike driver  A popular Mexican influencer has been shot dead while doing a live stream on social media outside a restaurant in Sinaloa state, where lethal cartel violence has become widespread.
César Gastélum, who had nearly 600,000 followers on TikTok and was known for making comedy videos, was filming with two friends outside a fast-food restaurant in the city of Culiacán.
The three were dressed in the bright orange jackets and backpacks of food delivery drivers.

stories.title: Peruvian cardinal hails $150m lead poisoning settlement for 1,300 people as a ‘historic milestone’
bullet_points: Cardinal Pedro Barreto received death threats and harassment during his almost 20-year campaign against a US mining company’s operations in the Andes  A Peruvian cardinal who received a barrage of death threats when he challenged the firm behind a toxic smelter has called a $150m (£111m) out-of-court settlement to more than 1,000 people who were allegedly poisoned by the plant as children “a historic milestone”.

Cardinal Pedro Barreto, 82, was in Rome meeting  Pope Leo XIV  and other cardinals in June when he received news that the firm that ran the smelter, the Doe Run Company, a subsidiary of Renco Group,  would pay $150m to 1,373 Peruvians  who have suffered health impacts since childhood.

The National Autonomous University of Mexico (Unam) said the exam would take place in person after its first attempt at a fully remote online version led to a debacle and thousands of annulled results.

stories.title: US to shut five consulates as critics fear China could fill diplomatic vacuum

The US Congress has been served notice of the impending closures, which are being justified on cost grounds and follow a reassessment of the US’s bilateral relationships with a range of countries since Donald Trump returned to the White House in January 2025.

stories.title: ‘Morocco feels emboldened’: Trump’s influence in spotlight after Ceuta disaster
bullet_points: Washington-Rabat ties under scrutiny as questions swirl over what led to deadly  influx into tiny Spanish territory  The cosy relationship between Washington and Rabat has long been flaunted by both sides, from Morocco’s announcement this year that it would be the first African state to join Donald Trump’s  Board of Peace  to the congratulatory message recently sent by Trump to mark King Mohammed VI’s 27 years in power.
The latest example landed this week.

As Spain grappled with the aftermath of  the sudden influx  – and swift return – of more than 70,000 people into Ceuta, Morocco’s monarch confirmed  he had named  a $1bn highway flanking the disputed territory of Western Sahara after Trump.
